data_description.dataset_name: MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily Global 500m

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global daily snow cover from MODIS Terra satellite with 500m resolution. Provides comprehensive monitoring of snow-covered areas across all terrestrial regions.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily snow cover measurements from 2000-02-24 to present in the Earth Engine asset.

band_semantics.NDSI_Snow_Cover: Normalized Difference Snow Index snow cover (0-100 percent)
band_semantics.NDSI: Raw Normalized Difference Snow Index value

data_description.important_note: Snow cover data based on Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) algorithm with additional criteria tests. MODIS provides long-term consistent snow cover record critical for climate studies, water resource management, and ecosystem monitoring. The 500m resolution enables detection of snow cover in complex terrain and fragmented landscapes.
analytical_capabilities: Seasonal snow cover extent and duration analysis
Snowmelt timing and water resource forecasting
Climate change impact on cryosphere monitoring
Mountain snowpack assessment for water management
Snow albedo feedback and energy balance studies

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDSI_Snow_Cover in percent (0-100). Values represent fractional snow cover within each pixel. Snow albedo in percent (0-100).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Filter by quality flags to remove cloud-contaminated pixels. NDSI threshold of 0.4 typically indicates snow presence. Snow albedo only valid over snow-covered areas.

data_description.data_source: NASA MODIS Terra satellite via Google Earth Engine
